name: Summit AZ - Service Page Rewrites and Claim Cleanup
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Statewide service pages (no city) rewritten or cleaned of claims that break the business rules. Four draft files: two full rewrites (Sep 25), a hub claim cleanup (Sep 25) and a 4-page claim cleanup (Oct 8).

# Files
| File | Pages | What | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Summit-AZ-Faucet-Toilet-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | /faucet-and-toilet-plumbing-services/ (10181) | Rewrite from generic filler on "plumber for toilet repair" (33,100 / KD 28); 3 maintenance headings became searched questions; 5 unapproved claims removed; hero now "Serving Mesa and the East Valley" | Live Sep 25 |
| `Summit-AZ-Shower-Bath-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | /shower-bath-repair-installation-services/ (10237) | Rewrite on "shower repair" (1,900 / 16); removed warranty and guarantee claims, shower door and cracked tub services, remodel builds; EPA WaterSense leak figures | Live Sep 25 |
| `Summit-AZ-Hub-Claim-Cleanup-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | /fixture-installation-services/, /garbage-disposals/, /water-heaters/ | 46 exact-phrase edits: guarantees, years of experience, "leading" claims, speed claims, maintenance plans, "bonded", puffery, a spliced sentence. Brand pillars and coupons kept | Live (handoff: 46 hub claim edits) |
| `Summit-AZ-Claim-Cleanup-Draft-2026-10-08.md` | /water-softeners/, /leaking-pipe-repair-in-arizona/, /pipe-lining-apache-junction/, /pipe-lining-chandler/ | "Summit Plumbing" to "Summit Plumbing Pros", "years of industry experience", em dashes, "same-day" button, epoxy and "50+ years" claims | Partly applied |

# Decisions and status
- Oct 7 to 8 (change log): Kim approved "only the brand-name fixes" on /water-softeners/ (17 instances, experience claim removed) and the em dash fix on the leaking pipe page. The epoxy and button changes on the other pages were not recorded as applied.
- /home-warranty-plumbing/ was excluded (keep, noindex or remove is Scott's decision).
- Faucet and shower pages: Oct 7 boost added a 3-question FAQ to the shower page and FAQPage plus Service schema to both. Oct 9 schema recheck: their 10-city areaServed matches visible text.
